name: Weak close + VIX term structure in backwardation → buy the open, hold to 15:55
why: A weak close while near-term fear is priced above 3-month fear is forced de-risking at its most acute; dealers and dip buyers absorb it and the next session mean-reverts. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_vix_term_structure.md).
